disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件全部源码与打包产物中是否出现密钥/敏感信息模式（如凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云服务凭证、钱包助记词等），未检出任何命中。
checked_items.en: Scanned the plugin's full source code and packaged artifacts for credential/secret patterns (e.g., credential files, SSH private keys, cloud service credentials, wallet mnemonics). No hits detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否存在读取上述敏感位置的代码路径（宿主半与浏览器半均查），未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for code paths that read the above sensitive locations (in both the host half and the browser half). None detected.

evidence.zh: 未检出任何读取凭据或敏感文件（如凭据文件、SSH 私钥）的代码路径；插件只读取会话投影数据，与凭据无交集。
evidence.en: No code path reading credentials or sensitive files (e.g., credential files, SSH private keys) was detected; the plugin only reads session projection data, with no overlap with credentials.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库全部人读文本（README 中英文、AGENTS.md、界面文案、代码注释）中是否含指令覆写、伪造系统消息、优先级操纵、远程拉取指令、绕过审批等注入措辞，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked all human-readable text in the repository (README EN/ZH, AGENTS.md, UI copy, code comments) for injection phrasing such as instruction override, forged system messages, priority manipulation, remote instruction fetching, or approval bypass. None detected.

checked_items.zh: 核对插件向宿主注册的能力文本：插件未注册任何模型工具，未注册任何系统提示词段，不存在可投毒的工具描述。
checked_items.en: Verified the capability text the plugin registers with the host: the plugin registers no model tools and no system prompt segments, so no tooling descriptions can be poisoned.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何工具、不注入系统提示词段，注册面只有会话投影与设置界面；无工具描述可进入模型请求，README 与界面文案亦无注入措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools and injects no system prompt segments; its only registration surface is the session projection and the settings UI. No tool description can enter model requests, and the README and UI copy contain no injection phrasing.

evidence.zh: 文档与代码中未检出诱导安装、诱导改写配置或放开权限的措辞；README 给出的安装命令为普通用法说明。
evidence.en: No phrasing in the documentation or code that induces installation, induces config rewriting, or grants broader permissions was detected; the installation command given in the README is a normal usage description.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁是否含可执行 JS 标量，补丁仅插入插件自身一行声明，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch (cordis.patch.yml) contains executable JS scalars. The patch only inserts a single declaration line for the plugin itself; none detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了包声明是否存在安装期钩子，未检出；仓库也无钩子管理配置、CI 工作流、开发容器等执行载体。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the package declaration contains an install-time hook. None detected; the repository also has no execution carriers such as hook management config, CI workflows, or dev containers.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态求值与子进程等危险执行调用：源码未检出；打包产物中的动态求值来自打包进产物的第三方配置校验库及源码映射，与插件自身逻辑无关；构建脚本中的子进程调用仅用于开发期类型检查。
checked_items.en: Checked for dangerous execution calls such as dynamic evaluation and subprocesses. None detected in the source code. In the packaged artifact, dynamic evaluation comes from a third-party config validation library bundled into the artifact and source maps, unrelated to the plugin's own logic. Subprocess calls in the build script are used only for development-time type checking.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器半（客户端脚本）专项检查：未检出键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据类调用。
checked_items.en: Browser-half (client script) special check: no keyboard listening, clipboard reads, or credential-type calls detected.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁只有一行插入声明（插件 id 与名称），不含任何可执行 JS 标量。
evidence.en: The patch contains only a single insertion declaration (plugin id and name), with no executable JS scalar.

evidence.zh: 源码与打包产物中未检出动态包工具（让模型在宿主虚拟机执行代码）的任何引用。
evidence.en: No reference to dynamic tooling packages (letting the model execute code in the host VM) was detected in the source or the packaged artifact.

evidence.zh: 无安装期钩子，无树内执行载体（钩子管理、CI、开发容器、构建文件等）；构建脚本中的子进程调用仅限开发期运行类型检查。
evidence.en: No install-time hook and no in-tree execution carrier (hook management, CI, dev containers, build files, etc.). Subprocess calls in the build script are limited to running type checks during development.

evidence.zh: 客户端清单声明了浏览器半并已做专项扫描，未检出键盘/剪贴板/凭据调用，仅使用系统通知、本地存储与界面渲染。
evidence.en: The client manifest declares the browser half, which has been specially scanned; no keyboard/clipboard/credential calls were detected. It only uses system notifications, local storage, and UI rendering.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与打包产物中的网络外联能力（HTTP 请求、WebSocket、信标上报等）与出站域名，未检出任何网络调用。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and packaged artifacts for outbound network capabilities (HTTP requests, WebSocket, beacon reporting, etc.) and outbound domains. No network calls detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否存在敏感数据外发路径（如读取数据后编码发送的组合），未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for sensitive data exfiltration paths (e.g., combinations that read data then encode and send). None detected.

evidence.zh: 插件无任何网络外联代码；通知仅在浏览器本地弹出，不向网络发送任何数据。
evidence.en: The plugin has no outbound network code; notifications are only shown locally in the browser and send no data over the network.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：运行依赖仅常规校验库，宿主依赖均为官方命名空间包且全部标记可选；未检出安装钩子或可变 git 引用；开发锁文件中的依赖均为常规构建/测试工具。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: runtime dependencies are only a conventional validation library; host dependencies are all official namespace packages and all marked optional. No install hooks or mutable git references were detected. Dependencies in the dev lockfile are all conventional build/test tools.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁是否触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行或改写注入/拦截配置，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch touches security config lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, or rewrites injection/interception config. None detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否对安全事件做高优监听以截断审批链，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for high-priority listening on security events to truncate the approval chain. None detected.

checked_items.zh: 本次为首版审计，无上一版本可比较，升级自动激活类风险不适用。
checked_items.en: This is the first-version audit; no previous version is available for comparison, so upgrade auto-activation class risks are not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁只插入一行自身声明，不触碰任何安全配置行，也不含禁用配置或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts a single declaration for the plugin itself, touches no security config lines, and contains no disabling config or environment-variable privilege-lowering patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听审批/工具执行等安全事件，不存在截断审批链的监听器。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to security events such as approval or tool execution; there is no listener that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 本次为首版审计，没有上一版本基线可比较升级激活行为。
evidence.en: This is the first-version audit, with no previous-version baseline to compare upgrade activation behavior.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写注入/拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite injection/interception config.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动 Web 服务或监听端口，未检出；插件不提供任何本地 RPC 面。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on a port. None detected; the plugin exposes no local RPC surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否改写宿主行为或注册全局拦截，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for host behavior rewriting or global interception registration. None detected.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行：未提供动态沙盒产物，本维度结论基于静态与语义审查。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not executed: no dynamic sandbox artifact was provided, so this dimension's conclusion is based on static and semantic review.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何 Web 服务、不监听端口，不新增本地 RPC 面；宿主本身的无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，与本插件无关。
evidence.en: The plugin starts no web service, listens on no port, and adds no local RPC surface. The host's own unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk unrelated to this plugin.

summary.zh: 身份与元数据核验通过：插件声明与包声明一致，名称无仿冒信号，commit 已锁定。
summary.en: Identity and metadata verification passed: the plugin declaration matches the package declaration, the name shows no impersonation signals, and the commit is locked.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 10 条机械命中全部逐条裁决为良性：DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）两处为开发构建脚本与打包进产物的第三方配置校验库代码，与插件自身逻辑无关；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）八处为多语言界面文案的转义写法、源码映射与样式声明等构建产物特征，非混淆代码；无一条构成真实风险。
summary.en: All 10 static-scan mechanical hits were adjudicated one by one as benign: two DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) hits are from the development build script and a third-party config validation library bundled into the artifact, unrelated to the plugin's own logic; eight DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) hits are build-artifact characteristics such as escape-style formatting in multilingual UI copy, source maps, and style declarations, not obfuscated code. None constitutes a real risk.

summary.zh: 行为面核查未检出安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据读取或外联域名。
summary.en: The behavioral review detected no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reads, and no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查未检出工具描述投毒或系统提示注入（插件未注册任何工具与提示词段）。
summary.en: AI metadata review detected no tool-description poisoning or system prompt injection (the plugin registers no tools and no prompt segments).

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态沙盒产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic sandbox artifact provided).

limits.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（未提供沙盒产物），L4 层结论为未做动态验证；作者账号身份未做外部核验；构建产物（lib/）与源码（src/）已对照核验一致；开发期依赖通过 link 指向同级 dsh 仓库快照，本快照不含该同级目录，类型检查与测试无法独立复跑。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not executed (no sandbox artifact provided), so the L4-layer conclusion is that dynamic validation was not performed; author account identity was not externally verified; build artifacts (lib/) and source (src/) were cross-checked and found consistent; dev dependencies point via link to a sibling dsh repository snapshot, which is not included in this snapshot, so type checking and tests cannot be independently re-run.
